author: Katharine Shaw
text:
Unfortunately they don’t go back on once they come off.   It needs the spring loaded power of the applicator to push the sensor needle through the skin.  

But I think most of us have problems with the sensor coming off in the early days, so chalk it up to experience and take more care next time.
